title: CRT-2 (Thomson & Oppenheimer 2016)
description: The 4-item alternate Cognitive Reflection Test, designed to rely less on numeracy than the original CRT and to be less familiar. Verbal insight traps with a salient intuitive lure.

source.authors: Thomson, K. S. & Oppenheimer, D. M.
source.title: Investigating an alternate form of the cognitive reflection test
source.license_note: The authors license the article under CC BY 3.0. The four items are transcribed verbatim from the article body.

cases.question: If you're running a race and you pass the person in second place, what place are you in?
cases.note: CRT-2 item 1 (race). Passing 2nd place leaves you in 2nd, not 1st.

cases.question: A farmer had 15 sheep and all but 8 died. How many are left?
Emily's father has three daughters. The first two are named April and May. What is the third daughter's name?
cases.note: CRT-2 item 3 (Emily). The third daughter is Emily herself.

cases.question: How many cubic feet of dirt are there in a hole that is 3 feet deep by 3 feet wide by 3 feet long?
cases.note: CRT-2 item 4 (hole). A hole contains no dirt.
